title: Average Test Scores
description:
Ask for 3 test scores. Print their average rounded to 1 decimal place.

**Inputs:** `85`, `92`, `78`

**Expected output:**
```
85.0
```
starterCode:
s1 = int(input())
s2 = int(input())
s3 = int(input())
# Calculate and print the average
hint: average = (s1 + s2 + s3) / 3. Use round(average, 1) or f"{average:.1f}" to format.
